"INSERT INTO AGP.FIS_UN_INBOUND_DISC
WITH EXT AS (SELECT DISTINCT EXT.BLEI_CK, EXT.BLIV_ID, EXT.BLSH_INVOICE_DTM, EXT.PDBL_ID FROM AGP.STT_GBD_BLSB_Extract EXT 
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = EXT.GRGR_CK
WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%SUP%''),
FIS AS(SELECT DISTINCT BLEI_CK, ITEM, CREATE_DATE, PDBL_ID FROM AGP.FIS_UNEARNED_INBOUND_DETAIL FIS
WHERE FIS.INBOUND_SUMMARY_ID IN  
(SELECT DISTINCT BATCH_ID FROM AGP.FIS_UNEARNED_INBOUND_BATCH)
AND CA_PARENT_GRP_ID LIKE ''%SUP%''
AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(CA_COVERAGE_TO_DT, CA_COVERAGE_FRM_DT) > 0)
SELECT EXT.BLEI_CK, EXT.PDBL_ID, EXT.BLIV_ID, EXT.BLSH_INVOICE_DTM, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 2 FROM EXT WHERE (EXT.BLIV_ID, EXT.PDBL_ID) NOT IN (SELECT FIS.ITEM, FIS.PDBL_ID FROM FIS)
UNION
SELECT FIS.BLEI_CK, FIS.PDBL_ID, FIS.ITEM, TO_CHAR(FIS.CREATE_DATE, ''YYYY/MM/DD HH:MI:SS''), SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 2 FROM FIS WHERE (FIS.ITEM, FIS.PDBL_ID) NOT IN (SELECT EXT.BLIV_ID, EXT.PDBL_ID FROM EXT)"

scripts.text:
SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(CREATE_DATE),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MINDATE, TO_CHAR(MAX(CREATE_DATE),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MAXDATE FROM AGP.FIS_UNEARNED_INBOUND_DETAIL 
WHERE INBOUND_SUMMARY_ID IN  
(SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM AGP.FIS_UNEARNED_INBOUND_SUMMARY
WHERE TO_CHAR(LOAD_DTM, 'DD-MON-YY') IN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD-MON-YY') AND STATUS_ID = 9)
AND CA_PARENT_GRP_ID LIKE '%SUP%'
AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(CA_COVERAGE_TO_DT, CA_COVERAGE_FRM_DT) > 0

UPDATE AGP.FIS_UN_INBOUND_DISC
SET UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, STATUS = 1
WHERE (BLEI_CK, BLIV_ID, PDBL_ID) IN 
(SELECT DISTINCT DET.BLEI_CK, DET.ITEM, DET.PDBL_ID FROM AGP.FIS_UNEARNED_INBOUND_DETAIL DET
 INNER JOIN AGP.FIS_UN_INBOUND_DISC DISC ON DISC.BLIV_ID = DET.ITEM AND DISC.BLEI_CK = DET.BLEI_CK AND DISC.PDBL_ID = DET.PDBL_ID
 INNER JOIN AGP.FIS_UNEARNED_INBOUND_SUMMARY SUM ON DET.INBOUND_SUMMARY_ID = SUM.ID
 WHERE DISC.STATUS = 2 AND SUM.STATUS_ID = 9)
 AND STATUS = 2
